Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

> At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people.

> Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!
# You Are
The Imaging Subject Matter Expert (SME) provides integrated clinical, operational, and technical expertise to advance enterprise imaging solutions for federal healthcare clients.
This role serves as the primary advisor for radiology and cardiology operations, enterprise imaging workflows, imaging informatics, PACS/RIS environments, and quality oversight functions.
The SME evaluates current‑state infrastructure and operations, develops actionable recommendations for workflow efficiency, scalability, staffing alignment, technical support models, and operational Contribute to proposal development, including content writing and color‑team reviews.
# The Work
# Pre‑Program Solicitation/Award
- Collaborate with capture and proposal teams to prepare for targeted solicitations.
- Support clinical and technical components of pre‑solicitation/solicitation development.
- Coordinate and support teaming/partner engagement and review cycles.
- Contribute to proposal development, including content writing and color‑team reviews.
# Radiology & Cardiology Operations Assessment
- Evaluate current‑state radiology, cardiology, and teleradiology infrastructure and operations.
- Review and interpret data to develop actionable recommendations for program deliverables.
- Assess routine clinical workflows, staffing utilization, workload distribution, modality mix, TAT performance, and operational dependencies.
- Recommend improvements to operational effectiveness, scalability, workflow efficiency, and sustainability.
# Enterprise Imaging & Technical Workflow Analysis
- Assess enterprise imaging operations and technical support structures including:
- PACS
- RIS
- Voice recogition systems
- Enterprise imaging platforms
- AI‑enabled workflows
- Interoperability and workflow integrations
- Evaluate enterprise imaging staffing models and technical support frameworks.
- Assess workflow dependencies involving:
- Oracle Health Millennium
- VistA
- DICOM routing
- CVIX workflows
- MPI/patient identity resolution
- HL7/FHIR interfaces
- Imaging data integrity and continuity
- Recommend future‑state enterprise imaging modernization opportunities and operational enhancements.
# Workflow & Performance Optimization
- Conduct workflow mapping and process analysis across clinical, radiology, cardiology, and technical operations.
- Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, workflow variation, and technical constraints.
- Support development of demand‑capacity models and performance thresholds.
- Provide recommendations to enhance throughput, responsiveness, workflow standardization, and enterprise imaging scalability.
- Conduct organizational change management (OCM) reviews and support OCM planning.
# Quality Management & Clinical Oversight
- Assess enterprise clinical quality management functions including:
- Peer review workflows
- OPPE/FPPE processes
- Management reviews
- Safety lookback activities
- Quality governance structures
- Evaluate operational impacts of quality oversight workflows on staffing and radiology operations.
- Collaborate with quality management stakeholders to support future‑state improvements.
# Here's What You Need
- Bachelor’s degree in Radiologic Sciences, Radiologic Technology, Cardiovascular Technology, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, Biomedical Informatics, Biomedical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Minimum 10 years of experience supporting radiology operations, teleradiology services, enterprise imaging environments, or imaging informatics.
- Demonstrated experience with PACS/RIS administration or operational support, imaging interoperability, clinical imaging workflows, and healthcare workflow analysis.
- 7–10+ years of experience in imaging informatics, including enterprise PACS administration, design, implementation, optimization, or migration.
- Experience designing and implementing PACS, VNA, diagnostic viewers, workflow engines, routing systems, disaster recovery, and long‑term archiving.
- Expert‑level knowledge of DICOM (query/retrieve, storage, MWL, MPPS, structured reporting, DICOMweb, routing, troubleshooting, metadata reconciliation, lifecycle management).
- Experience integrating imaging platforms with EHR/RIS ecosystems (Oracle Health/Cerner Millennium, VistA Imaging, etc.) across radiology, cardiology, pathology, ophthalmology, wound care, and other specialties.
- Experience with VNA/content migration (data inventory, retention policies, normalization, reconciliation, validation, cutover, rollback, decommissioning).
- Knowledge of imaging infrastructure (Windows/Linux, networking, DNS, certificates/TLS, load balancing, VMs/containers, storage tiers, HA, capacity planning, performance monitoring).
- Ability to develop requirements, architecture diagrams, interface specifications, test plans, runbooks, configuration management artifacts, and evaluation criteria.
- Federal healthcare experience (DoD, DHA, MHS, VA or similar), ideally with distributed multi‑facility systems.
- Familiarity with federal security/privacy requirements (RMF, NIST 800‑53, FISMA, HIPAA, Privacy Act, ATO processes, vulnerability remediation).
- Eligibility for Public Trust; Secret clearance only if required.
- Knowledge of VistA/Enterprise Imaging and DoD clinical imaging systems preferred.
# Bonus Points If
- Experience with federal healthcare environments, national teleradiology programs, enterprise imaging modernization, or multi‑site healthcare systems
- Experience evaluating AI‑enabled imaging workflows, imaging analytics, and clinical quality management functions
- Professional certifications: CIIP, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, or equivalent.

# Get to know our team
In Product, ideas come alive.
The world moves fast, and our culture is built on ownership, speed, and minimal bureaucracy.
This is the environment that empowers you to make decisions, move quickly, and do what you believe is right.
Our Product Managers move fast, learn from failure, and continuously iterate.
As a product-centric organization, we work cross-functionally to build products from conception to launch, bringing together engineering, design, data, and business teams.
Agoda Product Managers work closely with executive leadership and have high visibility across the organization, with direct impact on the company’s growth and strategy.
We put travelers first and aim to create exceptional travel experiences through innovative product thinking.
# The opportunity
This role is based in Bangkok/Seoul based.
Our Senior Product Managers are analytical, hands-on, and highly data-driven.
They are responsible for building products end-to-end, using analysis, experimentation, and rapid iteration to create solutions that are tailored to traveler needs.
As our next Senior Product Manager, Localization (Korea Market), you will define product strategy and drive execution for experiences serving Korean travelers.
You will partner closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities, build impactful products, and deliver high-quality solutions for the Korea market.
You will work with dedicated engineering resources that you help prioritize and allocate.

- Develop a deep understanding of the online travel ecosystem, market dynamics, competitive landscape, and user needs in the Korea market
- Define, build, launch, and optimize products and features through testing, experimentation, and rapid iteration
- Drive localization initiatives that improve the experience for Korean travelers across the product journey
- Partner closely with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions
- Translate market insights, customer needs, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps
- Use data and quantitative analysis to identify opportunities, prioritize effectively, and measure product performance
- Collaborate across regions, product areas, and functions to solve complex problems and drive meaningful business impact
# What you’ll need to succeed
- Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline
- Proven ability to use analytics and quantitative methods to inform strategy, prioritization, and decision-making
- Strong data skills, with the ability to independently analyze performance and generate actionable insights
- Excellent communication skills in either Korean with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and influence a wide range of stakeholders
- Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and influence a wide range of stakeholders
- Proven experience in Korea market localization, with a deep understanding of Korean consumers, market dynamics, and local product requirements
- Experience developing, launching, and optimizing products in a fast-paced environment
- Experience leading product strategy, go-to-market thinking, and cross-functional product development discussions
- Strong entrepreneurial mindset and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complexity and drive change
- Hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and execution

The right person for this role has extensive knowledge in Quality Management System (QMS) systems, data analysis, and continuous improvement to help shape our internal systems, tools, procedures and the culture of quality at Anduril.
If you are someone who loves to build world-class Quality processes, work hands-on, help others succeed on the quality journey, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology.

- Drive compliance with NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107 (Mutual Acceptance of Government Quality Assurance and Usage of the Allied Quality Assurance Publications), STANAG 4159 (NATO Quality Assurance Requirements for Design, Development and Production — AQAP-2110), and STANAG 4161 (NATO Quality Management System Requirements for Aviation, Space and Defense — AQAP-2310).

- Liaise with the UK MOD Quality Assurance representatives, the Defence Quality Assurance (DQA) organisation, and NATO Quality Assurance authorities to support Government Quality Assurance (GQA) activities and audits.

- Communicate with external audit agencies, including UKAS-accredited certification bodies and NATO quality assurance authorities. Support customer audits as necessary.
- Manage the QMS internal audit program and lead internal audits.
- Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities that benefit the QMS and product quality, aligned with AS9100, NATO AQAP, and STANAG frameworks.
- Support investigations, initiatives, and projects as needed, at the team or organisation level.
- Support developing QMS training modules and packages, including UK/NATO-specific regulatory and STANAG training. Facilitate training records and retention with manager of affected trainees.
- Drive root cause analysis and corrective action with internal findings from audits and customer visits, including UK MOD and NATO audit findings.
# Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree and 3–5 years of experience in aerospace and/or defence manufacturing.
- Expert knowledge of QMS requirements and auditing in a complex product environment, in one or more of the following QMS standards: ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, AS9110C, AS9120B, AS6500, IATF 16949:2016, ISO 13485:2016, TL 9000 R6.3.
- Demonstrable knowledge of NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107, STANAG 4159, STANAG 4161, and their associated Allied Quality Assurance Publications (AQAPs): AQAP-2110, AQAP-2210, and AQAP-2310.
- Familiarity with UK MOD Defence Standards (DEF STANs) and Government Quality Assurance (GQA) processes.
- Understanding of UK regulatory frameworks relevant to defence manufacturing, including UK Export Control Act 2002, HSE regulations, and UKCA/CE marking requirements.
- Working knowledge with QMS software solutions which might include Net Inspect, Siemens, SAP, ETQ, One Factory, MasterControl, Compliance Quest, Hexagon, PTC, QT9.
- Hands-on experience with data analytics platforms, reporting tools, and basic data visualisation.
- Demonstrated project management for software system implementation and onboarding suppliers (external users) and internal users.
- Working knowledge of design, development, manufacturing, supply chain, deployment, contracts, and other organisations that are part of a company-wide audit.
- Knowledge of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and Business Intelligence (BI) systems.
- A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive projects from start to completion.
- Proven track record of implementation and success with QMS.
- Right to work in the United Kingdom.
- Expected travel up to 20% of the time, including travel to US facilities and NATO partner sites.

# ABOUT THE TEAM
At Anduril, our Electronic Warfare (EW) team is redefining how we dominate the electromagnetic spectrum.
We’re moving away from slow, legacy defense hardware to build agile, software-defined EW systems that deploy real-time detection, geolocation, and defeat capabilities directly to the tactical edge.Based out of our Costa Mesa HQ, our team builds the hardware and software behind systems like Pulsar—tackling high-stakes mission sets like Counter-UAS, Electronic Countermeasures (ECM), Direction Finding, and cognitive RF sensing in contested environments.
# ABOUT THE ROLE
Anduril is seeking a Senior Systems Integration & Test Engineer to drive the verification, automation, and operational deployment of our next-gen Electronic Warfare systems.
You will collaborate closely with cross-functional hardware, software, firmware, and RF teams to lead integration testing across subassemblies and full systems.
From designing robust automated test suites and analyzing system telemetry to rapid failure triage and root-cause diagnosis, you will be instrumental in ensuring system reliability.
Additionally, you will serve as a technical liaison during system deployment, traveling to support internal and customer-facing flight tests and field demonstrations.

- Design and implement automated tests to increase test coverage, repeatability, and overall testing efficiency.
- Triage and troubleshoot system-level failures observed during integration and characterization to rapidly identify root causes.
- Analyze system telemetry and test data to reproduce issues, validate software/hardware fixes, and ensure system reliability.
- Serve as a key technical liaison to deploy Anduril’s integrated hardware-software products, ensuring they meet customer and operational needs.
- Travel to support flight tests and system demonstrations at both internal and customer-facing sites, validating Anduril’s EW capabilities in real-world operational environments.
# REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- 8+ years of relevant industry experience with a strong focus on hardware, software, and system-level verification and validation testing.
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Highly proficient with RF test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, multimeters, oscilloscopes, and vector network analyzers.
- Comfortable navigating Linux environments, utilizing command-line interfaces, executing shell scripts, and working with debugging utilities.
- Experience using programming languages such as Python or MATLAB for data parsing, telemetry analysis, and test automation.
- Strong root-cause analysis and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex, system-level issues.
- Ability to travel up to 40% of the time to support testing, integration, and demonstrations at remote and outdoor field sites.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational and interpersonal abilities.
- Currently hold and are able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.
# PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Direct experience working with Software-Defined Radios (SDRs) and EW systems.
- Familiarity with common wireless communication protocols and their associated test methodologies.
- Understanding of military standards (such as MIL-STD-810 or MIL-STD-4and spectrum regulatory test methods.
- Thrive in fast-paced, highly autonomous environments and can execute effectively with minimal direction.
- Experience using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
